name: otacli
tagline: A terminal anime client, forked with its licence honoured.
summary: A Python terminal client that streams through mpv and yt-dlp, previews with chafa, syncs progress with AniList, keeps an offline library, and installs on Windows through an Inno Setup installer. A GPL-3.0 fork of doccli that carries an explicit COPYRIGHT file crediting the original, because a fork's first obligation is to say what it is.

swe.angle: 430 commits on a GPL fork that keeps its attribution straight, with a Windows installer and AniList sync.

highlights: Explicit COPYRIGHT attribution to the upstream project, kept under the GPL-3.0 the original chose.
Ships a Windows installer, so a terminal tool reaches people who do not build from source.
